title: phyllota diffusa
intro: Phyllota diffusa, commonly known as New Zealand tea tree, is a plant species native to Australia and New Zealand, characterized by its small, yellow flowers and its use in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Phyllota diffusa include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to inhibit the growth of bacteria, viruses, and fungi, making it a potential treatment for various infections. The bioactive constituents of Phyllota diffusa include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
